lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 567 Complaint No. File Number 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What was handcuffed? Her hands or her legs or both?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And what were they handcuffed to?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like the hand like there is round poles on each side.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Of his bed? (Brendan nods “yes”) And you, your, your gettin' there OK. Lets back up again and did you go get the mail?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: When you went to get the mail with your bike did you hear somethin' at that time or did it happen when you came back with the mail?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You can do it. Just tell us the truth.
